Installments and Deposits!

At the end of the checkout process you'll be redirected to our payment gateway where you'll be able to pick and choose how you want to pay for your items. We make this process as simple as possible, providing straightforward options, depending on the product(s) you're ordering.

Terms and Conditions Summary

  1. Prices are, depending on your location, inclusive or exclusive of sales tax. This information will be clear during checkout.
  2. First 4 Figures reserves the right to add relevant taxes and/or tariffs at time of final invoice (where applicable).
  3. Current shipping fees are estimates only, as the package dimensions or the courier's shipping policies may change at a later time.
  4. Final invoice to be sent to your registered email once the product is ready to ship. Shipping fee indicated in that email will be final.
  5. Your product will be shipped after all amounts due have been paid.
  6. Deposits are non-refundable. For cancellations, a fee of $5.00 will be charged for every payment to be refunded.
  7. For the time being, we only accept payments in USD. The final payment/refund will be made at the conversion rate charged by your card provider at the actual time of payment/refund.
  8. Due to custom regulation rules and restrictions batteries will not be included for shipments in Asia. We are currently looking for other options but nothing has been determined as of now and for the foreseeable future.
